notes.title: Multi Player Beta Is Here!
notes.notes:
We're thrilled to announce multi player beta for Crystalline Bliss!  Dive into the action with your friends in various ways:

[list]
[*][b]Join Quick Match: [/b]Jump into games instantly.
[*][b]Host Public Games: [/b]Open your lobby to players from around the world.
[*][b]Invite to Private Games: [/b]Enjoy matches with just your friends.
[/list]
Additionally, we're introducing the ability to host your own matchmaking server for a personalized multiplayer experience. For more details on setting this up, check our GitHub page or join the conversation on our Discord server.


What else is new?

[list]
[*][b]Ghost Sets: [/b]Preview where crystals will fall, strategizing your next move.
[*][b]Drop Sets Faster[/b]: Use the space bar (keyboard) or the Y button (controller) for quicker action.
[*][b]Enhanced AI:[/b] Single-player games are now more challenging and engaging, thanks to improvements in computer player AI.
[*][b]Balanced Difficulties:[/b] We've fine-tuned the game's difficulties, making certain effects less frequent to ensure a fairer and more enjoyable experience.
[/list]

Dive into these updates and discover a more exciting and user-friendly gaming experience. We can't wait to see you and your friends in the game!
